#include <bits/stdc++.h>
 
using namespace std;
 
#define fore(i, s, e) for(int i = s; i < e; i++)
#define pb push_back
#define ALL(a) a.begin(), a.end()
#define SZ(a) ((int)a.size())
#define mset(a, b) memset(a, b, sizeof(a))
#define fst first
#define snd second
 
typedef long long ll;
 
typedef ll tf;
typedef ll tc;
const tf INF=1e9;
struct MCF{
	int n;
	list<tuple<tc, int, int, tf, tc>> prio, pot; list<tf> curflow; list<int> prevedge,prevnode;
	priority_queue<pair<tc, int>, vector<pair<tc, int>>, greater<pair<tc, int>>> q;
	struct edge{int to, rev; tf f, cap; tc cost;};
	vector<vector<edge>> g;
	MCF(int n):n(n),prio(n),curflow(n),prevedge(n),prevnode(n),pot(n),g(n){}
	void add_edge(int s, int t, tf cap, tc cost) {
		g[s].push_back((edge){t,SZ(g[t]),0,cap,cost});
		g[t].push_back((edge){s,SZ(g[s])-1,0,0,-cost});
	}
	pair<tf,tc> get_flow(int s, int t) {
		tf flow=0; tc flowcost=0;
		while(1){
			q.push({0, s});
			fill(ALL(prio),INF); 
			prio[s]=0; curflow[s]=INF;
			while(!q.empty()) {
				auto cur=q.top();
				tc d=cur.fst;
				int u=cur.snd;
				q.pop();
				if(d!=prio[u]) continue;
				for(auto &e:g[u]) {
					int v=e.to;
					if(e.cap<=e.f) continue;
					tc nprio=prio[u]+e.cost+pot[u]-pot[v];
					if(prio[v]>nprio) {
						prio[v]=nprio;
						q.push({nprio, v});
						prevnode[v]=u; prevedge[v]=g[v].size()-1;
						curflow[v]=min(curflow[u], e.cap-e.f);
					}
				}
			}
			if(prio[t]==INF) break;
			fore(i,0,n) pot[i]+=prio[i];
			tf df=min(curflow[t], INF-flow);
			flow+=df;
			for(int v=t; v!=s; v=prevnode[v]) {
				auto &e=g[prevnode[v]][prevedge[v]];
				e.f+=df; g[v][e.rev].f-=df;
				flowcost+=df*e.cost;
			}
		}
		return {flow,flowcost};
	}
};

int T = 500; // I'm supposing this works

int main() {
  int n, m, k, c, d; 
  cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
  int N = n*T;
  MCF mcf(N + 2);
  for i in range(n):
    for j in range(T):
      mcf.add_edge(i * T + j, i * T + j + 1, float('inf'), c)
  for i in range(T):
    mcf.add_edge(i, N + 1, float('inf'), 0)
  for i in range(k):
    x = int(input()) - 1
    mcf.add_edge(N, x * T, 1, 0)
  for i in range(m):
    x, y = map(int, input().split())
    x, y = x - 1, y - 1
    for j in range(T - 1):
      cur = 1
      for _ in range(k):
        mcf.add_edge(x * T + j, y * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c)
        mcf.add_edge(y * T + j, x * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c)
        cur += 2
  p = mcf.get_flow(N, N + 1)
  assert(p[0] == k) 
  print(p[1])
  return 0

import heapq
import sys

class MCF:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.prio = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.pot = [0] * n
        self.curflow = [float('inf')] * n
        self.prevedge = [0] * n
        self.prevnode = [0] * n
        self.g = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add_edge(self, s, t, cap, cost):
        self.g[s].append((t, len(self.g[t]), 0, cap, cost))
        self.g[t].append((s, len(self.g[s]) - 1, 0, 0, -cost))

    def get_flow(self, s, t):
        flow = 0
        flowcost = 0
        while True:
            q = []
            heapq.heappush(q, (0, s))
            for i in range(self.n):
                self.prio[i].clear()
                self.prio[i].append((float('inf'), i))
            self.prio[s].pop()
            self.prio[s].append((0, s))
            self.curflow[s] = float('inf')
            while q:
                d, u = heapq.heappop(q)
                if d != self.prio[u][0][0]:
                    continue
                for e in self.g[u]:
                    v = e[0]
                    if e[3] <= e[2]:
                        continue
                    nprio = self.prio[u][0][0] + e[4] + self.pot[u] - self.pot[v]
                    if self.prio[v][0][0] > nprio:
                        self.prio[v].pop()
                        self.prio[v].append((nprio, v))
                        heapq.heappush(q, (nprio, v))
                        self.prevnode[v] = u
                        self.prevedge[v] = len(self.g[v]) - 1
                        self.curflow[v] = min(self.curflow[u], e[3] - e[2])
            if self.prio[t][0][0] == float('inf'):
                break
            for i in range(self.n):
                self.pot[i] += self.prio[i][0][0]
            df = min(self.curflow[t], float('inf') - flow)
            flow += df
            for v in range(t, s, -1):
                e = self.g[self.prevnode[v]][self.prevedge[v]]
                e[2] += df
                self.g[v][e[1]][2] -= df
                flowcost += df * e[4]
        return (flow, flowcost)

T = 500

N = n * T
mcf = MCF(N + 2)
for i in range(n):

for i in range(T):

    x, y = map(int, input().split())
    x, y = x - 1, y - 1
    for j in range(T - 1):
        cur = 1
        for _ in range(k):
            mcf.add_edge(x * T + j, y * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c)
            mcf.add_edge(y * T + j, x * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c)
            cur += 2
p = mcf.get_flow(N, N + 1)
assert(p[0] == k)
print(p[1])
